decisions.quote: When the results of this study are compared with the aggregate results of the Sirieix et al. study ( 2011 ), three of the factors of the most preferred strategy that emerged in this study are similar to those outlined by Sirieix et al. These three factors are indicated in Table 7 , with a correction mark (‘✓’) next to the reason. However, two of the factors from the least preferred strategy of this study were part of the most preferred strategy of Sirieix et al.
decisions.reason: The shipped outcome relies on an abstract statement confirming agreement only on the top two individual factors, whereas in the results and discussion the authors explicitly conclude that there are both similarities and differences with Sirieix et al. (2011), including reversed factor rankings and strategy preferences.
